description: This file implements the RoomCalendarRepository class, which provides data access methods for calendar events, leaves, and astrology data in a calendar and astrology app. It interfaces with a Room database and defines suspend functions for CRUD operations and fetching data based on specific criteria.

classes.name: RoomCalendarRepository
classes.description: A repository class that manages calendar events, leaves, and astrology data, interfacing with the database via DAO objects. It uses Kotlin coroutines for asynchronous data operations.

methods.name: getEventsForDate
methods.description: Retrieves a list of calendar events for a specific date by querying the database and converting entities to models.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Inserts a new calendar event into the database.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event in the database.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getLeavesForDate
methods.description: Retrieves leaves for a given date.

methods.name: deleteLeave
methods.description: Deletes a leave record by ID.

methods.name: getAstrologyForDate
methods.description: Fetches astrology details for a specific date, if available.

methods.name: updateAstrology
methods.description: Inserts or updates astrology details for a specific date.

methods.name: getEventsModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves events modified after a certain timestamp.

methods.name: getLeavesModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves leaves modified after a certain timestamp.

methods.name: getAstrologyModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves astrology data modified after a certain timestamp.
